pages.heading: What Is Heritage?
pages.body:
Heritage denotes the registrant's innate magical nature, declared at the point of registration by way of the Heritage selection process.

The recognised Heritage categories are: Wizardkind, Werewolf, Obscurial, Goblin, House-Elf, Veela, Giant, Centaur, Vampire, and Merpeople. Pure-blood, Half-blood, and Muggle-born are not categories in their own right but Variants of Wizardkind, as set out below.

Heritage is permanent. It may not be altered after registration save by submission of a Ministry variance (Form 17B), which is rarely granted and never on a Tuesday.

pages.heading: Heritage Variants
pages.body:
Each Heritage carries one or more Variants, denoting a specific sub-classification within the category.

Variants determine the registrant's passive magical bonuses and the conditions under which certain abilities become available.

The witch or wizard in question is directed to consult their registration certificate for their assigned Variant. The Ministry does not issue replacement certificates by owl.

pages.heading: Restrictions by Heritage
pages.body:
Certain spells, abilities, and locations are accessible only to registrants of the appropriate Heritage. Specifics are set out in the relevant chapters of this Handbook.

Any attempt to circumvent a Heritage restriction is a Level 3 Misuse of Magic Offence, and will be treated as such irrespective of the registrant's stated intentions.
